verdict.rationale: Skyfire's own controls only partly match this story. Sellers can set identity requirements on a service, and Skyfire hard-gates access: token creation fails if a buyer agent is not verified to the required level. Allowing a specific identified agent or agent platform through is left to the merchant's site or bot manager, with Skyfire supplying only the KYA identity. Missing for 10: per-agent or per-platform allow/deny lists managed in Skyfire, any rate-limiting controls, catalog-level versus checkout-level access policies, and independent corroboration.
